chunks: Surely those who have taken the calf (as a god) will suffer the anger of their Lord, and disgrace in the world. That is how We requite those who fabricate lies.

key_terms.الْعِجْلُ: The golden calf worshipped by the Israelites

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for the Israelites who worshipped the golden calf according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual consequence of the golden calf incident: divine wrath and social humiliation, serving as a paradigm for those who fabricate falsehoods against God. The term 'Al-Mufitirun' (fabricators) is often interpreted to include not only the idolaters but also those who invent religious innovations or distort divine truth, a concept central to Shia theological discourse on authenticity.
